Browser endpoint must be a valid ws:// or wss:// URL, not http://

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import BrowserConfig, CrawlConfig, create_engine, scrape
from crawlberg import CrawlError

async def main() -> None:
    try:
        engine_config = CrawlConfig(browser=BrowserConfig(endpoint="http://not-websocket:3000", mode="always"))
        engine = create_engine(engine_config)
        url = "https://example.com"
        await scrape(engine, url)
    except CrawlError as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

asyncio.run(main())
```
